A is a bit leaner and keeps its changes tighter, but it never mentions the black version, and its case against the gradient rests mostly on the trend argument. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers clearly recommend keeping the identity. Answer A names more of what already works, including the black one-color receipt version, and explains more concretely why a gradient fails: it turns to mud in one color, on receipts and on embroidery. It also lists the real conditions that would justify a rebrand.
